title: Salt City Activity Fair debuts in Syracuse to combat adult loneliness
summary: State Sen. Rachel May is launching the Salt City Activity Fair on September 20, 2026, a community initiative designed to address adult loneliness by connecting residents with social activities and hobby groups. This represents a constituent-focused wellness and community engagement initiative relevant to the CIO's broader innovation and quality-of-life objectives.
